scientific_integrity: A finite, exact, exhaustive face/lattice certificate is supplied and tied to the toric smoothness criterion. The explicit unimodular equivalence with the four-cycle stable-set polytope is disclosed; stronger equivalent coverage elsewhere remains a possible originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Only the normal-fan toric variety of the size-three polytope is classified. The reduced singular support and generic transverse types, not the nonreduced Jacobian scheme or nongeneric completed germs at the two triple vertices, are asserted.
title: Five conifold curves on the three-by-three alternating-sign-matrix toric fourfold
